where.if: AND ( b.banner_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

mapper.sql: SELECT b.banner_id AS bannerId, b.banner_title AS bannerTitle, b.image_url AS imageUrl, b.target_project_id AS targetProjectId, p.title AS targetProjectTitle, p.project_status AS targetProjectStatus, b.target_session_id AS targetSessionId, s.city_name AS targetSessionCityName, s.station_name AS targetSessionStationName, s.start_time AS targetSessionStartTime, s.session_status AS targetSessionStatus, b.enable_status AS enableStatus, b.sort_order AS sortOrder, b.start_time AS startTime, b.end_time AS endTime, CASE WHEN p.project_id IS NULL THEN 'TARGET_PROJECT_MISSING' WHEN b.target_session_id IS NOT NULL AND s.session_id IS NULL THEN 'TARGET_SESSION_MISSING' WHEN p.project_status = 'OFFLINE' THEN 'TARGET_PROJECT_OFFLINE' WHEN s.session_status = 'OFFLINE' THEN 'TARGET_SESSION_OFFLINE' WHEN b.enable_status != 'ENABLED' THEN 'DISABLED' WHEN NOW() < b.start_time THEN 'NOT_STARTED' WHEN NOW() > b.end_time THEN 'EXPIRED' ELSE 'EFFECTIVE' END AS effectiveStatus, b.create_time AS createTime, b.update_time AS updateTime FROM banner_item b LEFT JOIN performance_project p ON p.project_id = b.target_project_id LEFT JOIN performance_session s ON s.session_id = b.target_session_id AND s.project_id = b.target_project_id
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM banner_item b LEFT JOIN performance_project p ON p.project_id = b.target_project_id
ORDER BY b.sort_order ASC, b.banner_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM banner_item WHERE banner_id = #{bannerId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM performance_project WHERE project_id = #{projectId}
SELECT project_status FROM performance_project WHERE project_id = #{projectId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO banner_item ( banner_title, image_url, target_project_id, target_session_id, enable_status, sort_order, start_time, end_time, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{bannerTitle}, #{imageUrl}, #{targetProjectId}, #{targetSessionId}, #{enableStatus}, #{sortOrder}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE banner_item SET banner_title = #{bannerTitle}, image_url = #{imageUrl}, target_project_id = #{targetProjectId}, target_session_id = #{targetSessionId}, enable_status = #{enableStatus}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, start_time = #{startTime}, end_time = #{endTime}, update_time = NOW() WHERE banner_id = #{bannerId}
UPDATE banner_item SET enable_status = #{enableStatus}, update_time = NOW() WHERE banner_id = #{bannerId}
